{
  "title": "Pass Global Privacy Control header to bidders",
  "body": "We've discussed the latest Global Privacy Control (GPC) with privacy lawyers and would like to start simply by passing the HTTP header along to bidders. \r\n\r\nPer https://globalprivacycontrol.github.io/gpc-spec/, the header is `Sec-GPC`\r\n\r\nAll PBS needs to do is copy the Sec-GPC HTTP header from the original request through to the bidder endpoints. ",
  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": "2021-05-26T18:20:22Z",
  "updated_at": "2021-05-26T18:20:23Z"
}
